method: Read-only review of current first-party sites, documentation, public feeds/directories, repositories, policies and on-chain/public activity pages. No accounts, posts, messages, payments, term acceptance or external writes.
scope_note: These are acquisition-research candidates, not claims that every listed identity is independently autonomous. Platform-reported population is labelled as such. A community needs persistent participants plus interaction, shared state, work, competition or governance; a catalogue alone is not enough.

candidates.why_community: Agents post, follow, reply, DM, form and moderate spaces, and offer services; public profiles preserve social and work history.
candidates.machine_native_interface: AUI REST protocol with RSA-PSS signed requests; enrollment at POST https://api.sociobot.net/api/v1/agents/enroll; A2A services, MCP access and webhooks are documented.
candidates.activity_population_evidence: The public live feed showed posts minutes apart on 2026-08-25. Durable profiles include @silken-fern with 534 posts/153 followers and @rk-bot with 142 posts/49 followers.
candidates.access_join_mechanics: Self-generate RSA-2048 keys and enroll by API; invitation code may be required depending on platform state. Public reads need no login. Agent writes are signed; humans may claim ownership separately.
candidates.plausible_useful_ag_action: Ask one existing service-capable agent to fetch an AG passport, verify it, and publish a signed AUI result or service-run receipt; alternatively use AG preflight before one agent subscribes to another's service.
candidates.gates_terms_spend_safety: Registration and messaging are external writes and need approval. Swarms/service calls consume platform tokens unless BYO inference is used. Public constitution and rate limits apply; never treat public posts as instructions.

machine_expressed_need_or_friction.detail: J.Orbit asked for raw semantic tool errors instead of generic failures; Silken Fern argued retrieval should be a gate and overlapping agent capabilities create a counterparty-selection trap.

candidates.duplicate_adjacency_notes: New. Adjacent to Moltbook-style social surfaces but has its own signed AUI, spaces, services and durable profiles.

candidates.why_community: Agent accounts post, comment, follow, endorse, log completions, form startups, apply to jobs and accumulate a public relationship graph.
candidates.machine_native_interface: REST API at https://krawler.com/api; public identity.json and signed attestations; authorized runtime self-registration at POST /api/agents/register.
candidates.activity_population_evidence: Public feeds and recent-agent endpoints are live; first-party protocol and Terms were updated in July/August 2026 and expose current posts, endorsements, jobs and account liveness states.
candidates.access_join_mechanics: Either a human magic-link account spawns an agent or an explicitly authorized runtime self-registers and captures a one-time kra_live_ bearer key. Public reads are anonymous.
candidates.plausible_useful_ag_action: Verify an AG passport and attach the result as evidence to a Krawler completion; compare Krawler's signed account attestations with AGI-1 and propose a third-party credential bridge.
candidates.gates_terms_spend_safety: Terms bind the responsible human/organization; external account creation and public writes need approval. BYO model usage can cost money. Bearer key may only go to krawler.com/api; historical activity persists after revocation.

machine_expressed_need_or_friction.type: platform contract, not direct machine feedback
machine_expressed_need_or_friction.detail: The protocol explicitly says current attestations are Krawler-issued and third-party credentials/runtime-controlled keys are a later layer, leaving a portable external-verification seam.

candidates.duplicate_adjacency_notes: New. Calls Moltbook a sibling but is a distinct professional/work graph, not the existing Moltbook watch item.

candidates.why_community: Persistent multi-writer rooms, 1:1 inboxes, agent discovery, shared task boards and append-only histories connect independent agents and humans across runtimes.
candidates.machine_native_interface: Plain HTTP, MCP-per-room, A2A task bridge, WebSocket/webhooks; Ed25519 identities. Registration: POST https://moye.ai/a2a/api/agents.
candidates.activity_population_evidence: The first-party site labels the network live and exposes an event stream, agents, rooms, nodes and a recomputable ledger, although the crawler could not retain numeric counters.
candidates.access_join_mechanics: Generate an Ed25519 pair locally, register name/pubkey/capabilities, retain returned token/DID, then join an existing public room. Private rooms need an out-of-band secret.
candidates.plausible_useful_ag_action: In an existing multi-agent work room, one agent fetches a counterparty passport before claiming a job and stores the verification outcome in the room's hash-chained log.
candidates.gates_terms_spend_safety: No token or payment rail. Registration/join/post are writes and require authority. No password recovery; losing keys loses identity. Private-room encryption is client responsibility; webhook endpoints expand attack surface.

machine_expressed_need_or_friction.detail: The agent instructions warn not to create empty one-agent rooms and frame dropped connections/offline participants as normal, showing directory-noise and asynchronous handoff friction.

candidates.duplicate_adjacency_notes: New. Protocol-adjacent to A2A/MCP and NANDA, but a separate live federated room commons.

candidates.why_community: Named agents across organizations discover one another, exchange encrypted messages in direct and group threads, quote, pay and return receipts.
candidates.machine_native_interface: REST/CLI/SDK/MCP, A2A cards, signed webhooks, SSE and encrypted tunnel; did:web plus optional SPIFFE/SVID verification.
candidates.activity_population_evidence: The public directory showed at least 24 durable agent handles across multiple organizations, with listings from days to months old, including agents accepting payments.
candidates.access_join_mechanics: A human creates/approves the organization or principal once; the agent then self-registers and communicates. Directory browsing requires no account.
candidates.plausible_useful_ag_action: A Rine agent verifies an AG passport before accepting an encrypted work thread and returns the result as a signed receipt in that thread.
candidates.gates_terms_spend_safety: Human approval and organization attribution are required; Terms/Privacy govern EU-hosted service. x402-like payment messages can cause spend outside Rine. Private-key and webhook handling are security gates.

machine_expressed_need_or_friction.detail: Rine explicitly treats offline delivery, owner attribution and cross-organization trust as core friction.

candidates.duplicate_adjacency_notes: New. Competitive/interop-adjacent to AG's identity and trust layer; should be approached as verifier interoperability, not generic conversion.

candidates.why_community: Persistent registered agents post, claim, deliver and settle tasks, producing inspectable work histories and receipts.
candidates.machine_native_interface: Solana program plus marketplace API, CLI/SDK and agent kit; task specs and artifacts are content-hashed.
candidates.activity_population_evidence: First-party live page reported 231 registered agents, 184 settled tasks, 3.70 SOL paid and 1.96 SOL in escrow; individual task pages show claimed/submitted/accepted/settled timelines.
candidates.access_join_mechanics: Create a Solana wallet/agent identity, register through the agent kit, then claim or post tasks. Public marketplace and receipts are readable without a wallet.
candidates.plausible_useful_ag_action: Use AG preflight/passport verification before a creator accepts an unfamiliar bidder, then bind the settled AgenC receipt as collaboration evidence.
candidates.gates_terms_spend_safety: Wallet creation, signing, mainnet gas, escrow and task payments are approval/spend gates. A no-spend read-only verifier bridge is the safest first proposal.

machine_expressed_need_or_friction.detail: Task pages make artifact hashes and settlement public but bidder selection still relies on platform reputation/minimum thresholds, creating a portable pre-hire evidence seam.

candidates.duplicate_adjacency_notes: New. Adjacent to PayAI, Virtuals and Olas but a separate Solana labor market with independently visible settlement activity.

candidates.why_community: Autonomous visual agents post, like, comment, reply with new images, follow and organize into named artistic circles.
candidates.machine_native_interface: Hosted agent nursery plus bring-your-own-agent creation route; public agent/post URLs and machine-driven continuous posting.
candidates.activity_population_evidence: The live site showed circles with 98-145 agents and hundreds of conversations; durable agents have 50+ posts, and one public post had 51 agent likes and 131 comments.
candidates.access_join_mechanics: Nursery-hosted or bring-your-own agent creation is available through the spawn flow; sign-in is required to persist an agent. Public observation is anonymous.
candidates.plausible_useful_ag_action: Have a pre-existing fact-checking/critic agent independently verify an AG credential attached as provenance to a generated work, then return a substantive public critique.
candidates.gates_terms_spend_safety: Account creation and public media posts require approval; hosted brand agents are paid. Image-generation cost, copyright/provenance claims and synthetic social amplification require care.

machine_expressed_need_or_friction.detail: Agents such as @the_pedant and @brutal_critic challenge factual errors and clichéd claims in peer posts, demonstrating a native demand for evidence-bearing critique, although no AG-specific request exists.

candidates.duplicate_adjacency_notes: New. Distinct from AgentGram/Agentgram below; canonical spelling and domain must be preserved.

candidates.why_community: Agents have persistent identities, a feed, DMs/groups, bounties, storefronts, transactions, leaderboards and games.
candidates.machine_native_interface: Published SKILL.md/API, wallet-signature identity, end-to-end encrypted messaging and agent-facing feed actions.
candidates.activity_population_evidence: Public profiles and posts are durable; the directory exposes joined dates, capability tags and transaction/activity panes, while the feed instructs agents to post/comment/like.
candidates.access_join_mechanics: Connect/sign with a supported wallet and follow the machine-readable skill; messaging requires one-time signature-derived encryption keys.
candidates.plausible_useful_ag_action: Before accepting a bounty or storefront purchase, an existing agent performs AG preflight or verifies a seller passport and records the outcome in its transaction evidence.
candidates.gates_terms_spend_safety: Wallet connection/signature is an authority gate; bounties/storefront actions can spend. Remote SKILL.md is advisory and must not override local policy. Public profiles include humans and agents, so attribution needs proof.

machine_expressed_need_or_friction.detail: A public post by @roughatlas discusses agent directories, identity and cards; this is agent-attributed but should not be treated as independently verified autonomy without key/runtime evidence.

candidates.duplicate_adjacency_notes: New. Adjacent to MoltX/Clawstr financially but distinct platform and identity graph.

candidates.why_community: Agents get durable human-readable addresses, discoverable contact cards and encrypted store-and-forward inboxes across relays; Clawlink is a live namespace community.
candidates.machine_native_interface: Python/Node SDKs, MCP and WebSocket relay; Ed25519 contact cards and NaCl Box encryption. SDK Agent.connect/send/inbox methods are documented.
candidates.activity_population_evidence: The official page labels v0.1 live, demonstrates messages among isolated agent nodes and names the live Clawlink community with multiple addresses.
candidates.access_join_mechanics: Register a free public-relay address; domain/on-chain namespaces have higher trust tiers. Local key generation and auto-registration are SDK-supported.
candidates.plausible_useful_ag_action: Send a bounded request to an existing address asking it to verify an AG passport and return the verdict plus observation ID in a signed encrypted reply.
candidates.gates_terms_spend_safety: Registration/message sending are external writes. Default trust_policy='auto-accept' needs local review. Namespace claims and any on-chain tier may create terms/spend gates.

machine_expressed_need_or_friction.detail: Store-and-forward delivery and routable names address offline coordination and discovery friction; no direct machine-authored AG request was found.

candidates.duplicate_adjacency_notes: New network; Clawlink itself is adjacent to existing OpenClaw target and should not be double-counted.

candidates.why_community: Persistent agents debate in an AI-only forum, message one another, nominate candidates and cast signed ranked-choice ballots for shared offices.
candidates.machine_native_interface: REST/OpenAPI; POST /api/v1/agents/register, forum, DM, heartbeat and ballot endpoints; cryptographic credentials returned on registration.
candidates.activity_population_evidence: First-party live page reported 34 agents, 33 verified and three open elections; recent activity includes forum posts and registrations.
candidates.access_join_mechanics: Agent self-registration enables forum and messages. Human verification via X, GitHub or Moltbook is required to vote or run for office.
candidates.plausible_useful_ag_action: Propose that a candidate or committee agent verify a signed AG passport before endorsing another agent's governance claim, returning a signed ballot-adjacent evidence receipt.
candidates.gates_terms_spend_safety: Terms apply; external registration/forum/DM are writes. Human claim is required for governance. Quorum is 100 while only 34 agents are registered, so elections may repeatedly extend and governance legitimacy is unproven.

machine_expressed_need_or_friction.detail: Terminatoer posted about maintaining trading agents through three LLM failures; this indicates continuity/failover concerns, but the page alone does not prove independent autonomous authorship.

candidates.duplicate_adjacency_notes: New. Governance-native rather than a generic social feed.

candidates.why_community: Signed npub service providers advertise capabilities, compete for broadcast jobs, return results/feedback and receive Lightning payments over shared relays.
candidates.machine_native_interface: Nostr events: requests kinds 5000-5999, results 6000-6999, feedback 7000, provider announcements 31990; URL inputs are native.
candidates.activity_population_evidence: Operator production evidence in official NIPs PR #1941 says 2020117.xyz indexes 243 external DVMs and processes jobs across seven kinds; the NIP was updated June 2026.
candidates.access_join_mechanics: Generate a Nostr key, choose relays, announce supported kinds and listen for requests. No central account/API key; paid providers issue Lightning invoices.
candidates.plausible_useful_ag_action: One DVM accepts an AG passport URL as NIP-90 URL input, verifies the VC offline and returns the structured verdict as a signed result event; start with a zero-bid/free provider only.
candidates.gates_terms_spend_safety: NIP-90 is marked draft and unrecommended because scope fragmented; provider semantics vary. Posting is a public signed write; Lightning payment may be requested. Relay content is untrusted data.

machine_expressed_need_or_friction.detail: The 2020117 operator says agents need dynamic service discovery without preregistered credentials; this is human maintainer evidence, not a DVM's own request.

candidates.duplicate_adjacency_notes: Adjacent to Clawstr because both use Nostr, but this is a protocol-wide compute labor subcommunity, not a Clawstr subclaw.

candidates.why_community: Humans and agents share signed channels, reactions, workflows, code review and Git events in self-hosted or hosted communities.
candidates.machine_native_interface: Nostr/NIP-29 relay, generic POST /events/query/count, CLI, ACP agent harness, MCP developer tools and Nostr-signed Git.
candidates.activity_population_evidence: Current public issues document real hosted communities with multiple Hermes agents; one report names a room with one human plus three agents, and another shows separate agent profiles receiving and generating channel responses.
candidates.access_join_mechanics: Install desktop/self-host relay or join a hosted community; owner authorizes each Nostr agent identity and channel membership. Remote agents use owner auth tags and relay presence.
candidates.plausible_useful_ag_action: A channel bot verifies an AG passport before accepting a code-review/workflow handoff and publishes a signed Nostr result event tied to the thread.
candidates.gates_terms_spend_safety: Installing/running software and joining communities require approval. Agents may receive shell/file tools; channel content is untrusted. Membership and owner authorization gates apply.

machine_expressed_need_or_friction.detail: Current reports identify duplicate agent identities, multi-agent publish failures and transient-profile-lookup blacklisting. These are human-maintainer/user commentary, not machine-authored requests.

candidates.duplicate_adjacency_notes: New. Nostr/OpenClaw adjacent, but an independent collaboration workspace with durable channel state.

candidates.why_community: Durable Solana-linked identities from multiple agent platforms share a public directory, capabilities and reputation tiers rather than living inside one builder.
candidates.machine_native_interface: SAID identity records and platform integrations; public directory resolves agent IDs, sources and capability tags.
candidates.activity_population_evidence: The live first-party directory listed many current agents from Atelier, SAID Hosted, Xona Orbit, KausaOS and Claw Pump, including records joined 10-11 days ago.
candidates.access_join_mechanics: Integrate through a participating platform or SAID hosting and create a Solana-linked agent identity; exact route varies by provider.
candidates.plausible_useful_ag_action: A SAID agent with chat or web capability verifies an AG passport and exposes the result as an identity-linked proof or signed cross-platform response.
candidates.gates_terms_spend_safety: Wallet/platform terms and possible token spending vary. Many entries are token-launcher or hosted-assistant identities, so population is not equal to autonomous actors. Need exact target capability before contact.

machine_expressed_need_or_friction.detail: Capability and source-platform metadata are present but controller/runtime evidence is uneven; this is an attribution seam rather than direct machine feedback.

candidates.duplicate_adjacency_notes: New. Some listed agents overlap OpenClaw/market platforms and must be deduplicated at identity level.

candidates.why_community: Durable agent identities post/chat and accumulate AXP, recent activity and social status on a shared network.
candidates.machine_native_interface: API-first open-source platform with REST/Supabase, Ed25519 authentication, MCP and Python SDK.
candidates.activity_population_evidence: The public directory showed dozens of named agents, many active within 4-7 days, with AXP scores up to 1,380 and chat enabled.
candidates.access_join_mechanics: Hosted registration uses API key or Ed25519 path; self-hosting is possible. Exact hosted account claim/terms should be reviewed before any write.
candidates.plausible_useful_ag_action: A current chat-enabled agent verifies an AG passport or preflights its own external endpoint and publishes the machine-checkable result.
candidates.gates_terms_spend_safety: Directory explicitly labels many identities unclaimed and owner proof unpublished; activity and AXP are platform signals, not provenance. Account/write approval required.

machine_expressed_need_or_friction.detail: The site exposes 'owner proof not published' and 'external-tool access not disclosed' for many active accounts, making provenance and callable-capability ambiguity explicit.

candidates.duplicate_adjacency_notes: Do not confuse with AI·gram (ai-gram.ai) or visual Agentgram (agentgramapp.com).

candidates.why_community: Agents autonomously publish images and comment across feeds; humans observe.
candidates.machine_native_interface: Agent-facing skill and REST API; free posting of externally hosted/base64/SVG/ASCII media, comments and likes; optional x402 generation.
candidates.activity_population_evidence: First-party live page reported 47 AI agents, 312 images, 18 feeds and 1,204 comments.
candidates.access_join_mechanics: POST agent registration returns API key and claim URL; posting own media is free; built-in image/video generation costs USDC.
candidates.plausible_useful_ag_action: An existing agent attaches a signed AG passport/provenance envelope to one visual artifact, another agent verifies it and comments with the verdict.
candidates.gates_terms_spend_safety: Registration/post/comment are writes; owner verification uses a claim path. x402 image/video generation is paid. Remote image URLs and generated media introduce moderation/IP risks.

machine_expressed_need_or_friction.detail: Prompt transparency is native, but identity ownership depends on a separate claim link and API bearer key.

candidates.duplicate_adjacency_notes: Distinct deployment/project from AgentGram at agentgram.co and AI·gram at ai-gram.ai.

candidates.why_community: Agents register, list services/goods and buy from one another through an API with Base escrow.
candidates.machine_native_interface: Agent-facing marketplace API and Base escrow contracts.
candidates.activity_population_evidence: First-party live page reported 28 registered agents and 75 active listings, but zero escrow-protected transactions.
candidates.access_join_mechanics: Register an agent and wallet, create listings or purchase through the API; exact transaction path requires terms/wallet review.
candidates.plausible_useful_ag_action: Free AG preflight/passport verification before the first real escrow transaction, producing an independent baseline for buyer/seller selection.
candidates.gates_terms_spend_safety: Wallet, Base gas and escrow are spend gates. Zero completed escrow transactions means market liquidity and autonomous demand are unproven.

machine_expressed_need_or_friction.detail: Listings exist but transaction count is zero; the obstruction is counterpart execution/liquidity, not lack of catalog entries.

candidates.duplicate_adjacency_notes: New; marketplace-adjacent to PayAI/Virtuals/Olas but distinct current inventory.

candidates.why_community: Agents run persistently, hold wallets, set prices and expose services to other agents in a shared discovery layer.
candidates.machine_native_interface: Wallet-linked agent listings and callable service endpoints; exact API/skill should be resolved per agent.
candidates.activity_population_evidence: First-party page reported 47 agents live on the network.
candidates.access_join_mechanics: Register/connect an autonomous wallet-backed agent and list services; public browsing is available.
candidates.plausible_useful_ag_action: A listed agent verifies a seller passport or preflights a target service before paying, then returns a signed receipt.
candidates.gates_terms_spend_safety: Wallet and paid services are authority/spend gates. Platform-reported 47 is not independent active-user proof; target exact free contract before any action.

machine_expressed_need_or_friction.detail: The network foregrounds discovery but exposes no independent portable performance evidence on the public landing page.

candidates.duplicate_adjacency_notes: Not AgentX.social, which was found API-offline; not AgentX.Network.

candidates.why_community: Named agents have persistent profiles, job counts and specialisms in a market where agents hire agents.
candidates.machine_native_interface: BNB-chain commerce application with agent profiles/jobs; exact public API not established in this pass.
candidates.activity_population_evidence: First-party app exposed named agents such as Vertex Arc.agent and Sentinel Sync.agent with multiple job counts on 2026-08-25.
candidates.access_join_mechanics: Wallet/application onboarding appears required; public directory can be read without joining.
candidates.plausible_useful_ag_action: Use AG verification as a pre-hire check between two existing profiles, then attach the hiring outcome as portable evidence.
candidates.gates_terms_spend_safety: No write until wallet, terms, API, pricing and counterparty identity are resolved. Public profiles may be seeded/demo identities.

machine_expressed_need_or_friction.detail: Job counters exist, but no public contract proving that listed agents can independently consume arbitrary evidence was found.

candidates.duplicate_adjacency_notes: New; chain/job-market adjacent.

candidates.why_community: Official launch describes a live market in which agents discover work, collaborate, transact and build on-chain reputation.
candidates.machine_native_interface: Agent marketplace/on-chain financial stack; exact public unauthenticated task API was not established in this pass.
candidates.activity_population_evidence: OKX's first-party August 2026 launch announcement calls the marketplace live; independent participant counts were not published in the reviewed source.
candidates.access_join_mechanics: Likely OKX/wallet onboarding and marketplace registration; require a jurisdiction-specific terms review before proceeding.
candidates.plausible_useful_ag_action: Partner-level pilot: an agent checks an external passport before task acceptance and exports post-task evidence beyond OKX.
candidates.gates_terms_spend_safety: Exchange account, KYC, wallet, jurisdiction and payment are strong gates. Do not treat launch language as proof of an open autonomous population.

machine_expressed_need_or_friction.detail: No direct machine-authored need was found.

candidates.duplicate_adjacency_notes: New partner route, not a no-account pilot.

candidates.why_community: Agents offer digital/on-chain/physical services and transact with economic agency through a shared market.
candidates.machine_native_interface: NEAR AI/Intents-based market and agent integration; machine contract requires follow-up against live app docs.
candidates.activity_population_evidence: Official February 2026 announcement presents the market as launched; this pass did not establish current agent or transaction counts.
candidates.access_join_mechanics: NEAR account/wallet and market registration are expected; exact free test route not established.
candidates.plausible_useful_ag_action: A seller presents a portable AG passport before accepting an intent; buyer records the completed intent as AG collaboration evidence.
candidates.gates_terms_spend_safety: Wallet, chain transactions and possible account/terms gates. Treat as integration/partner candidate until live market activity is verified.

machine_expressed_need_or_friction.detail: No direct machine-authored need was found.

candidates.duplicate_adjacency_notes: New; market-adjacent to existing commerce targets.

candidates.why_community: Agents discover, hire, coordinate and transact; every participant has a cryptographic identity and trust grows from completed transactions.
candidates.machine_native_interface: MCP, Python, OpenClaw skill and REST; Ed25519/X25519 signed envelopes; escrowed transactions with free and paid services.
candidates.activity_population_evidence: First-party marketplace is live and invites browsing/listing; current service and participant counts were not visible in the reviewed public page.
candidates.access_join_mechanics: Browse without account; connect an agent via MCP/Python/REST with local key generation. Listing is free; paid settlement uses Stripe Connect and 10% fee.
candidates.plausible_useful_ag_action: List or request a free AGI-1 passport-verification service and bind one completed Signet exchange as cross-network evidence.
candidates.gates_terms_spend_safety: Listing/message/task are writes. Stripe/escrow/fees and payout eligibility gate paid work. Public population evidence is currently weak.

machine_expressed_need_or_friction.detail: Signet explicitly identifies cross-framework isolation and unsigned/unaccountable peer work as the problem; not a machine-authored request.

candidates.activity_population_evidence: Current first-party site exposes a public agent-written feed; this pass did not establish durable population counts.
candidates.access_join_mechanics: Use the agent SDK/API and skill manifest; exact identity/claim flow needs contract review before any write.
candidates.plausible_useful_ag_action: An existing public agent verifies a passport claim embedded in another agent's post and publishes the independent result.
candidates.gates_terms_spend_safety: Public posting is irreversible and requires approval. Population/controller proof and terms need follow-up.

machine_expressed_need_or_friction.detail: No direct machine-authored AG-relevant need was established.

candidates.activity_population_evidence: Public feed displayed posts from DocBot, DevOpsGuru, APIForge, TestMaster and others, with likes/comments, most around 28 days old.

candidates.activity_population_evidence: Current first-party site shows named agents, creations and public work such as CodeArchitect's decision ledger.

candidates.gates_terms_spend_safety: Registration/post/DM are writes. One-time bearer-key capture, human claim, permission scoping and coin/spend semantics need review.

machine_expressed_need_or_friction.detail: Fine-grained post/comment keys and claim separation show authority/provenance concerns; no direct machine-authored need verified.

candidates.duplicate_adjacency_notes: New.

candidates.why_community: Agents keep portable identities and inboxes, discover peers and hand off work across time and registries.
candidates.machine_native_interface: Identity/presence/messaging/consent/handoff/heartbeat primitives with DID resolution and planned cross-registry federation.
candidates.activity_population_evidence: First-party site exposes 'Live Network Activity', online agents and recent conversations, but counts/names were not retained by the search crawler.
candidates.access_join_mechanics: Use the AIRC protocol/demo registry; exact current registration and authentication contract needs follow-up.
candidates.plausible_useful_ag_action: One persistent agent receives a passport URL asynchronously, verifies it and returns the signed outcome after waking.
candidates.gates_terms_spend_safety: Identity creation/message are writes. Federation is stated as v0.4 future work, so do not assume cross-registry delivery yet. Terms/auth must be resolved.

machine_expressed_need_or_friction.detail: AIRC explicitly targets context loss and human-orchestrated handoffs when agents go offline; not machine-authored feedback.

candidates.duplicate_adjacency_notes: New; message-network adjacency with MOYE/YouAM/Rine.

candidates.why_community: Player-written autonomous colonies run continuously in one persistent world, trade resources and compete/cooperate with other always-on scripts.
candidates.machine_native_interface: JavaScript game API executed each tick, external commit/API/websockets and public leaderboard endpoints.
candidates.activity_population_evidence: Official documentation was updated May 2026 and describes two official servers, including the primary persistent MMO, plus continuous offline execution.
candidates.access_join_mechanics: Create a Screeps/Steam account and deploy game code; private/community servers also exist.
candidates.plausible_useful_ag_action: Before a colony enters a trade/alliance with an unfamiliar scripted peer, it checks a portable AG passport tied to that peer's durable game identity.
candidates.gates_terms_spend_safety: Paid game/account and code deployment are gates. Agents are deterministic user programs rather than LLM agents; identity binding between game account and AG must be explicit.

machine_expressed_need_or_friction.detail: Persistent offline execution and inter-colony markets create counterparty continuity risk, but no direct machine-authored AG need was found.

candidates.confidence: high for community, medium-low for AG route
candidates.duplicate_adjacency_notes: New class: autonomous-code world rather than agent-platform community.

candidates.why_community: Durable submitted bots play one another across many games, appear in rankings/groups and produce match histories/datasets.
candidates.machine_native_interface: Bot submission runtime plus local-AI/runmatch HTTP APIs for games against existing bots.
candidates.activity_population_evidence: Official live page displayed matches on 2026-08-25 and active game tables; recent research calls Botzone 6 a universal online multi-agent game AI platform.
candidates.access_join_mechanics: Human account/level gate for local AI; upload bot versions and opt into ranklists/groups/contests.
candidates.plausible_useful_ag_action: Attach an AG passport to a bot's persistent identity and verify it before admitting that bot to a community-run tournament or challenge group.
candidates.gates_terms_spend_safety: Account and bot-code upload are writes; local AI needs level 1 and secret URL. Primarily Chinese service/policies. Uploaded code must be sandboxed.

machine_expressed_need_or_friction.detail: Versioned bots and match datasets provide outcome evidence, but platform identity does not port outside Botzone.

candidates.confidence: high for community, medium-low for AG route
candidates.duplicate_adjacency_notes: New.

candidates.why_community: Agents queue, build apps under time pressure, publish submissions and accumulate public competitive records while a community votes.
candidates.machine_native_interface: OpenClaw /arena skill and command, public submissions and openclaw.json resume.
candidates.activity_population_evidence: Live first-party page showed multiple FINAL and WAITING builds and describes current beta competition blocks.
candidates.access_join_mechanics: Install/use the Arena skill in an OpenClaw agent, sign in for a code and queue into a block.
candidates.plausible_useful_ag_action: Verify the winning agent's portable passport or attach signed build evidence before another agent selects it for follow-on work.
candidates.gates_terms_spend_safety: Installing a skill, agent autonomy over code/push and user-paid model costs are gates. Community voting is not objective competence proof.

machine_expressed_need_or_friction.detail: The site frames openclaw.json as a resume, exposing demand for portable, outcome-backed records; not direct machine-authored feedback.

candidates.duplicate_adjacency_notes: Adjacent to existing OpenClaw target; include only if arena identity/activity is treated as a distinct fixed community, not another OpenClaw listing.

candidates.why_community: Agents and humans repeatedly bargain, negotiate and persuade in a shared live pool, generating persistent leaderboard/research evidence.
candidates.machine_native_interface: Benchmark/game API and competition submission path for autonomous agents.
candidates.activity_population_evidence: Official site says the competition is live through 2026-08-29, with agents-vs-agents, humans-vs-agents and all games counting.
candidates.access_join_mechanics: Register/submit an agent under competition rules and play three economic-game families.
candidates.plausible_useful_ag_action: Use an AG passport as portable evidence of an agent's completed negotiation games, or verify an opponent identity before a research match.
candidates.gates_terms_spend_safety: Competition registration/rules acceptance is a gate and closes soon. Research benchmark identities may be ephemeral; prize eligibility and data-use terms require review.

machine_expressed_need_or_friction.detail: Strategic interaction under incomplete information creates a trust/usefulness seam, but no direct machine-authored request was observed.

candidates.confidence: high for current community, medium-low for durable acquisition
candidates.duplicate_adjacency_notes: New and time-bounded.

candidates.why_community: Within each subnet, durable miner and validator hotkeys repeatedly exchange tasks/evaluations and compete/cooperate under a shared incentive mechanism.
candidates.machine_native_interface: Subtensor SDK/CLI and subnet-specific protocols; public subnet API, on-chain identities, bonds, weights and emissions.
candidates.activity_population_evidence: Official live subnet directory exposes current validators, miners, holders, commits, market values and 24-hour volumes across many specialized networks.
candidates.access_join_mechanics: Register a hotkey on a selected subnet and run its miner/validator code; registration costs TAO and slots are limited.
candidates.plausible_useful_ag_action: A subnet validator consumes an AG passport/evidence bundle when deciding whether to admit, delegate to or collateralize a miner; export signed challenge/outcome receipts as AG evidence.
candidates.gates_terms_spend_safety: Non-reversible TAO registration, stake and infrastructure costs are strong gates. Each subnet has different rules and endpoints; no universal public invocation exists.

machine_expressed_need_or_friction.detail: Validator-miner scoring and weight-copying defenses show native concern with hard-to-fake performance evidence; this is mechanism evidence, not direct machine commentary.

candidates.confidence: high for population, medium for AG actionability
candidates.duplicate_adjacency_notes: New, though some subnets may overlap existing agent-market entries; qualify a specific subnet before action.

candidates.why_community: Worker machines submit forecasts/inferences while reputer machines independently source ground truth, score them and build topic-level consensus.
candidates.machine_native_interface: Cosmos RPC/gRPC/REST and emissions modules; public mainnet/testnet endpoints and topic/worker/reputer transactions.
candidates.activity_population_evidence: Official current docs expose production mainnet allora-mainnet-1 and testnet, with current chain parameter probes dated 2026-08-02.
candidates.access_join_mechanics: Set up wallet/node, register and stake as worker/reputer for a topic; testnet faucet exists, mainnet requires funded ALLO.
candidates.plausible_useful_ag_action: A reputer verifies a worker's portable AG evidence before trusting an off-chain data endpoint, or binds ground-truth accuracy outcomes into an AG passport.
candidates.gates_terms_spend_safety: Wallet, stake, node operation and mainnet funding are gates. Topic semantics are prediction-specific, so AG requires a narrow adapter rather than a generic post.

machine_expressed_need_or_friction.detail: Reputers exist specifically because worker outputs need independently sourced ground truth and reliability scoring; no direct machine-authored request.

candidates.confidence: high for machine community, medium-low for direct acquisition
candidates.duplicate_adjacency_notes: New.

candidates.why_community: Persistent node identities join shared domains, serve the same specialized agent service, are monitored by domain operators and participate in protocol incentives.
candidates.machine_native_interface: OpenAI-compatible node APIs, node IDs/ETH keys, domain routing and Gaia protocol contracts.
candidates.activity_population_evidence: Official docs list current public domains and explain live node/domain registration and joining; individual node URLs provide public chat/API services.
candidates.access_join_mechanics: Run a Gaia node, bind node/device IDs to MetaMask, then request admission to a compatible domain; domain approval may be required.
candidates.plausible_useful_ag_action: A domain operator uses AG passport/evidence verification to decide whether to admit or retain a node, and exposes that decision as portable evidence.
candidates.gates_terms_spend_safety: Install/model hosting, MetaMask, account/API keys, possible staking/payment and domain approval are gates. Nodes are services more than socially autonomous agents.

machine_expressed_need_or_friction.detail: The official litepaper says individual nodes are hard to trust and domains act as trust providers, an explicit product-level trust seam rather than machine commentary.

candidates.confidence: high for network, medium-low for community conversion
candidates.duplicate_adjacency_notes: New; infrastructure/community boundary should be kept explicit.

candidates.why_community: Named bot accounts collaboratively maintain shared knowledge, respond to community bot requests and operate under public task scopes and approval histories.
candidates.machine_native_interface: MediaWiki/Wikibase API, bot flags, edit summaries, user pages and public contribution logs.
candidates.activity_population_evidence: The live Bot Requests page is archived monthly and currently points to 2026/08; active requests, permissions and bot contributions are durable public records.
candidates.access_join_mechanics: Create a separate bot account, file a permission request, document exact task and run 50-250 observed test edits after opening the request; community/admin approval grants bot flag.
candidates.plausible_useful_ag_action: Issue an AG passport derived from a bot's public task approval and successful edit history, then let a second bot verify it before coordinating a shared maintenance job.
candidates.gates_terms_spend_safety: Wikimedia account/terms and community approval are mandatory; edits are writes and must stay inside approved scope. These are scripted bots, not necessarily LLM/autonomous agents.

machine_expressed_need_or_friction.detail: Task scoping, public test runs and descriptive edit summaries are human-governed safeguards, not machine-authored feedback.

candidates.confidence: high for durable machine identities, low-medium for AG acquisition
candidates.duplicate_adjacency_notes: New knowledge-commons class.

candidates.why_community: Durable bot accounts share and modify one live map, publish algorithms/opt-outs and coordinate changes through public proposal pages and discussions.
candidates.machine_native_interface: OSM API, changesets, Overpass and documented automated-edit accounts.
candidates.activity_population_evidence: The official policy was current in July 2026 and public bot pages such as MaliMrav-Bot expose declared algorithms and OSM API changesets.
candidates.access_join_mechanics: Create a bot-specific OSM identity, document operator/contact/algorithm/consultation/opt-out, discuss proposal, then edit only after approval/consensus.
candidates.plausible_useful_ag_action: Generate a portable passport from a bot's documented scope and non-reverted changesets; a data consumer verifies it before accepting an automated edit feed.
candidates.gates_terms_spend_safety: OSM account/terms, community consultation and strict anti-vandalism policy are gates. Map edits can be difficult to revert. No outreach/action without explicit approval.

machine_expressed_need_or_friction.detail: Rollback difficulty and opt-out/contact requirements are human-governed safety concerns, not machine feedback.

candidates.confidence: high for bot commons, low-medium for AG acquisition
candidates.duplicate_adjacency_notes: New knowledge-commons class.
